subject: Texas AI Docket, Carousel No. 23, September 13th, 2026, The model scored 0.615.
body:
The model scored 0.615.

Carousel No. 23, September 13th, 2026

Shipped at 6.784

docket_build --validatepass
site_fresh_checkpass
house_style_checkpass, after 12 long sentences were split in the record
schema_checkpass

dossierspass

texanwarn, places yes and deadline yes, body no and next step no
absencespass, 9 of 9 scoped to a named document
numeralspass, 18 numerals over 9 frames, every one reachable

What degraded

  • The deck shipped 0.016 under the 6.8 bar, at the five round cap, with no hard fail outstanding. Two judges refused on the threshold rather than on a fault.
  • The deck's declared value arc collapsed. Nine frames were planned at medians of 22, 46, 34, 30, 26, 18, 72, 26 and 28 and measure 11.1 to 41.1, with four of them within half a point of each other at the floor.
  • Frame 4's bridge from the panel review into the second paper was named by three reader judges in three consecutive rounds and was not repaired before the cap.
  • Frame 3 does not resolve at feed width. Four judges said so across the five rounds and three rebuilds did not fix it.
  • Seven of nine frames open on one type skeleton. Only frames 2 and 7 break it.
  • The INSTRUMENT visual register has now recurred for a third run. dedupe_check structurally cannot see it, because it compares topics, entities and artwork.
  • tx-2026-0120 was left unstamped. Its single dhs.gov source returned 403 to the checker, to a browser user agent and to the fetch tool alike.
  • The scanner's daily ceiling could not be read. The Supabase connector's tools are not enabled in this session, so the query had nowhere to run and nothing about the cap is known today.
  • Frame 7's own acceptance item is not met. The two rows it names differ by 19.1 L* where it asks for more than 40, because they sit inside the step rather than either side of it. The edge runs 78.0 L* across 6 CSS pixels, so the drawing does what the item intended and the item asks the wrong two rows.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it The model scored 0.615., paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

The model scored 0.615.

That is on the 198 brain metastasis patients it was built on. Run unchanged on an independent 69 it had never met, it read 0.574. Its authors call that "limited standalone discrimination" and ask for cautious use.

An expert panel published the same day names the practice this sits inside. Radiologists at Baylor College of Medicine and Texas Children's Hospital in Houston and at UT Southwestern in Dallas put "off-label use of adult-trained AI models" among their concerns for children. "Unlike adults, children go through continuous physiologic and anatomic changes that require age-specific models trained on representative developmental data."

Both items are dated September 9th.

How much imaging AI in Texas is "off-label use of adult-trained AI models"?

#PediatricRadiology #TexasChildrens #UTMB

2. The first comment

The machine changed itself

  • panel_ready.py reads a value arc declared frame by frame inside the dossiers, not only as a summary paragraph, and reports a partial plan and a plan stated twice as their own findings
    Carousel 22 planned a median for all nine frames and wrote each one into that frame's own art.value_structure as `Frame median L* planned at 22`, which is the key SLIDE_DOSSIER_SPEC.md asks for the value structure in. No paragraph anywhere named the value arc, so arc_spans found nothing, planned_arc returned [], unreadable_plan returned [] because it only looks INSIDE an arc span, and the gate printed `(this storyboa
  • panel.py counts a scoring round as three judge cards it has not seen, instead of counting invocations of the combiner
    count_round appended one line per call and returned the length of the file, so every invocation was a round whatever it was called on. Carousel 22 ran five scoring rounds and the combiner was re-run once against a STALE integrity card while round 4's bookkeeping was being corrected. The counter read 6, the honest figure was 5, and the run had to write a prose correction into score.json beside the number. A counter le
  • Four upgrades were written into knowledge/carousel/UPGRADE_BACKLOG.md as proposals rather than built
    Each needs a file outside the upgrade lane. The one worth naming is that ten carousel gates have a --self-test CI never runs, measured rather than guessed, and panel_ready is one of them, so today's first upgrade is proved locally and by nothing else.

Each reverts on its own commit.

Notes

MERGED. The September 12th and September 13th decks are both on main, and the record now carries 133 items. Neither had merged before today, and the cause was the same for both. Each pull request was CONFLICTED with main, so GitHub could not build its merge ref and guards.yml had nothing to check out. No run ever started, which this run first misread as a permissions problem. Both branches are merged, resolved and green. THE TWO RUNS COLLIDED AND THE COLLISION IS RESOLVED. Both were cut from a 127 item record and both allocated tx-2026-0147 to 0149, to six different decisions, and both numbered their deck carousel 22. September 12th shipped first and keeps those ids and that number. September 13th's three admissions are now tx-2026-0150 to 0152, its three held seed items are 0153 to 0155, and its deck is carousel 23. THE CAPTION WAS REWRITTEN RATHER THAN RELABELLED. September 12th spent the opening move 'the plain question' and this run had already moved onto it, because that ledger was not merged when the caption room read its exclusions. The caption is rewritten on 'the number that is wrong', which is the move this story wanted anyway. The record's worklist was cleared in full. 115 items were due of 127 on the two day leash with nothing rotten. reverify confirmed 79 unchanged against their own quotes and the remaining 48 were checked by hand, one primary source each, because they sit behind PDFs, Legistar's JSON API and JavaScript rendered agenda centers that the string check structurally can't read. No claim moved. Three decisions were admitted. An AJR expert panel review with radiologists at Texas Children's and UT Southwestern among its authors, stating that pediatric imaging is substantially underrepresented across AI in radiology. An MD Anderson and UT Medical Branch MRI radiomics model whose discrimination fell on an outside cohort. ERCOT's market notice telling providers which large loads sit provisionally in Batch Zero, every placement conditional. Three were held in the seed for one reason, which is that no source in window names a Texas county. Kodiak AI's Permian driverless deployment, Galaxy Digital's Batch Zero classifications and the Texas A&M AgriLife far ultraviolet poultry trial. A statewide flag used to mean nobody could tell is a claim about scope that nobody checked, so each is held with its reason and a later run that finds the place can promote it. One item was left unstamped on purpose. tx-2026-0120, the Homeland Security facial biometric assessment at the Progreso International Bridge, rests on a single dhs.gov page that returned 403 to the checker, to a browser user agent and to the fetch tool alike. Its movement line says what is therefore unconfirmed rather than what the fetcher did. The primary share reads 635 of 717 claims resting on a primary document, across 226 documents from 101 publishers. All three admissions cite primary documents only, so the share was not moved down by them. The instruments are all green by exit code and none has stopped. The water map draws 119 pins and the readout says 119 reservoirs. house_style_check went red at Phase 16 on the record's own prose rather than on the deck. Twelve sentences over the 30 word backstop, across the three admitted items, two re-verify movement lines and one claim text. Every one was this project's own writing rather than quoted source text, each was split at a clause in the ledger and never in docs/, and the site was rebuilt from it. Nothing in this run waited on a human. prompt_audit measured 1843 tool calls across both processes and found no call that put a dialog in front of anybody, with a debug log present, so this is a measurement rather than the absence of one. It is the reading taken last, immediately before this email.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
